details.description: GLM-4.5V is a vision-language model from Z.ai (Zhipu AI) built on the GLM-4.5-Air architecture (106 billion total parameters, 12 billion active via mixture-of-experts), extended with image, video, document and GUI-screenshot understanding. It accepts images at any aspect ratio up to 4K resolution and long-form video, alongside charts, documents and desktop or mobile screenshots, and includes a switchable thinking mode for adjustable reasoning depth. Released August 11, 2025 under the MIT license.
advantages: Z.ai reports GLM-4.5V achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source vision-language models of similar scale across 42 public multimodal benchmarks spanning image, video, document and GUI tasks, per Z.ai's GitHub repository.
Outputs bounding-box grounding for visual element localization using normalized coordinates, per Z.ai's GitHub repository.
Supports GUI agent operations such as screen reading and desktop or mobile interface interaction (clicking, sliding), per Z.ai's API documentation.
Accepts images at any aspect ratio up to 4K resolution and long-form video for event recognition, per Z.ai's GitHub repository.
disadvantages: The maker states generated frontend code can produce unformatted HTML with rendering errors.
The maker states pure text question-answering capabilities need improvement relative to its multimodal capabilities.
The maker notes occasional overthinking, content repetition, or restating the answer at the end of a response.
The maker notes perception limitations in counting and identifying individual objects.
use_cases: Parsing charts, long documents and research reports
GUI agent automation such as screen reading and clicking
Video event recognition and long-form video analysis
Multi-image scene understanding and STEM problem solving with combined text and image input

notes: docs.z.ai lists a 16K max-output-token limit for GLM-4.5V, which differs from the catalog's max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens of 131072/131072 (matching Fireworks' listed 131,072-token context length); kept the catalog's values as instructed. No numeric per-benchmark scores (e.g. MMBench, MathVista) were found on a maker page I could open, only the aggregate '42 benchmarks, SOTA among open-source VLMs' claim, so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. Verify pass: Bud's catalog records this route's modality as text_input/text_output only, with no image or video input, unlike the vision-language capability (image, video, document, GUI-screenshot understanding) Z.ai documents for this model -- kept the catalog's modality value per RESEARCH_PROMPT and flag the mismatch here, consistent with how sibling VLM entries in this batch (e.g. qwen2-vl-72b-instruct, phi-3-vision-128k-instruct) handle the same conflict. Also, Z.ai's GLM-V GitHub repo now lists GLM-4.6V, GLM-5V-Turbo and GLM-5.3-Flash as newer vision-capable generations released after GLM-4.5V, and announced (2026-09-02) that this repository will no longer be maintained; no maker page explicitly calls GLM-4.5V itself deprecated or legacy, so no supersession claim is made in the visible fields, but this is more complete than the single-newer-model picture originally noted.
